{{Quote|Gorro's at the Blaster's Path. Local watering hole. Probably washing down some tonitran jerky with a Mantellian fungolager.|Qaraah|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Blaster's Path''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] run by [[Kareena]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Raider's Cove]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. It was frequented by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and criminals that inhabited Raider's Cove, including the [[Nova Blades]]. [[Weklae Baso]] worked as a bartender there.
